$comment: Manifest for building the prebuilt native dependencies (OpenSSL + libssh2) consumed by the libgit2 build. vcpkg builds these from its own maintained ports; the versions here are kept in lock-step with the openssl/libssh2 git submodules (the submodule tag is the authoritative version pin, asserted by build.deps.ps1). libssh2 uses the OpenSSL crypto backend with zlib disabled (libgit2 bundles its own zlib).
name: libgit2-native-deps
